title: Darkness Returns
description: Return the Skeleton Key to the Twilight Sepulcher, follow the Pilgrim's Path through its five tests, and restore the Ebonmere to earn Nocturnal's blessing as a true Nightingale Agent.

base_facts: I am a Nightingale bound to serve Nocturnal.
Mercer Frey betrayed the Nightingales and murdered Gallus.
I helped the new recruit retrieve the Skeleton Key from Mercer.

LISTEN_TO_NOCTURNAL: Nocturnal has emerged from the Ebonmere and is addressing us.
CHOOSE_NIGHTINGALE_ROLE: The new recruit must choose which Nightingale ability to receive from Nocturnal.

base_facts: I am the spirit of Gallus, the last Nightingale Sentinel.
I have guarded the Sepulcher alone for over twenty-five years.
Mercer Frey lured me to my death and stole the Skeleton Key.
Without the Key, the Ebonmere is closed and I am fading away.

SPEAK_TO_SENTINEL: A new Nightingale has come with the Skeleton Key. My death was not in vain.
FOLLOW_PILGRIMS_PATH: The recruit must follow the Pilgrim's Path alone to restore the Key to the Ebonmere.

base_facts: I am Nocturnal, the Daedric Prince of Darkness and Shadow.
The Ebonmere is my conduit to Evergloam.
The Nightingales serve me in exchange for their abilities.

LISTEN_TO_NOCTURNAL: The Key has been returned and the Ebonmere restored. I have emerged to address my agents.
CHOOSE_NIGHTINGALE_ROLE: I will grant this Nightingale a blessing befitting their chosen role.

beats.comment: Player enters the Twilight Sepulcher with the Skeleton Key.
Player speaks to Gallus's spirit and learns about the Pilgrim's Path and the Ebonmere.
Player navigates the five tests of the Pilgrim's Path through the Sepulcher.
Player unlocks the Ebonmere with the Skeleton Key.
Nocturnal emerges from the Ebonmere and addresses the player about their service.
Player speaks to Karliah and chooses a Nightingale blessing: Agent of Shadow, Subterfuge, or Strife.
Quest complete. Player has become a true Nightingale Agent with Nocturnal's blessing.
